about: [O6] Memory flat after a hundred cycles (brief O6 §3): the bed's hundred beat - a hundred things in the road - every one knocked over by a blast's push, held a moment, then everything mended (Smash.mendAll: the pools take back their instances and pieces), a hundred times; the JS heap and the renderer's geometries and textures read every 25 cycles. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6_memory.json
